topics.title: How the two games differ
topics.summary: Cards or record sheets, inches or hexes.

sections.heading: The same at heart
sections.body: Both games roll two dice against a target number, move the initiative loser first, land damage at the end of the phase, and chip armor before structure. Learning one helps with the other.

sections.heading: Cards or record sheets
sections.body:
Alpha Strike: one card per ’Mech with Move, damage, Armor, and Structure.
Classic: a full record sheet — every weapon, armor for each body location, critical slots, a heat scale, and pilot wounds.

sections.heading: Inches or hexes
sections.body:
Alpha Strike: a tape measure on any table. Range is 6, 24, and 42 inches.
Classic: a hex map. Each hex costs MP, turning costs MP, and each weapon has its own range in hexes.

sections.heading: One damage number or every weapon
sections.body:
Alpha Strike: one roll per ’Mech, and the card gives the damage at that range.
Classic: each weapon rolls to hit, each hit rolls a location, and missiles roll how many hit.

sections.heading: Moving and shooting
sections.body:
Alpha Strike: standing still makes your shot easier (−1), jumping +2, and the target’s “harder to hit” number is on its card.
Classic: standing still +0, walking +1, running +2, jumping +3, and the target’s modifier comes from how many hexes it moved.

sections.heading: Heat 0–4 or a 30-point scale
sections.body:
Alpha Strike: heat only comes from overheating and engine hits, from 0 to 4. At 4 you shut down.
Classic: every weapon and every move makes heat, heat sinks take it off, and a 30-point scale slows you, spoils your aim, and can shut you down or blow your ammo.

sections.heading: Criticals and falling
sections.body:
Alpha Strike: one roll on one critical table, and ’Mechs never fall over.
Classic: criticals hit specific slots — engine, gyro, actuators, ammo — and Piloting rolls decide whether a ’Mech falls.

sections.heading: Punches and kicks
sections.body:
Alpha Strike: one punch or kick for your Size in damage.
Classic: punch, kick, push, charge, and death from above, with damage from the ’Mech’s tonnage.

sections.heading: Time at the table
sections.body:
Alpha Strike: about an hour for 4 vs 4.
Classic: a few hours a game.

sections.heading: In Mech Buddy
sections.body: Alpha Strike is playable now, mission by mission. Classic isn’t playable yet; its rules are here to read.
